# Book

`writing`

A written account of one researched technology. Reading it teaches the technology without researching it, and the book is kept, so it can be read again or lent.

> Share knowledge by writing, never through a clan (ResearchSharedByWriting, Phase 203)

## Attributes

| Field | Type | Description |
| ----- | ---- | ----------- |
| teaches | string | The technology or recipe key it teaches, chosen when written |
| author | string | Player id of the writer |
| rules | json | Writing rule: { teaches, station, cost, consumedOnRead, writerMustKnow } (validated at fabric load) |

## Actions

### write

Write a book about something the writer knows

**Conditions:**
- Refused when the writer does not know the content
- Consumes the cost

### read

Read a book and learn what it teaches

**Conditions:**
- The reader learns it; the item is kept, so it can be read again and lent
